_about: Agent configurations. Each command runs in the task workspace. {prompt}, {prompt_file}, {workspace} and {model} are filled in; with "stdin": true the prompt is also piped in. CLI flags change between releases: run each command by hand once and adjust before a paid run. The agents run with permission prompts off so they can work unattended; `foames-bench run` puts them in a sandbox (--sandbox, README.md#sandbox). An optional "sandbox" object sets Docker options per agent: image, network, env (more variable names to pass in) and mounts ("host:target" read-only, "host:target:rw").

agents.name: reference
agents.notes: Applies the task's reference solution. Validates tasks and the grader.

agents.name: noop
agents.notes: Changes nothing. Every real agent must beat it.

agents.name: claude-code-frontier
agents.notes: Claude Code headless. Reports total_cost_usd itself. 'opus' is the CLI's alias for the current Opus model.

agents.name: codex-frontier
agents._prices: Fill in your provider's current prices to get estimated cost; zeros mean cost is reported as $0. Add "-m", "<model>" to choose a model.

agents.name: gemini-frontier
agents._prices: Fill in current prices. Add "-m", "<model>" to choose a model.

agents.name: opencode-local
agents.notes: OpenCode with a local Ollama model. Configure the ollama provider in opencode.json first; the model id is provider/model.

agents.name: aider-local
agents.notes: Aider drives one model per message and does not run tests on its own unless asked; the prompt asks.

agents.name: aider-gemini-flash
agents.notes: Aider on a free API tier; needs the GEMINI_API_KEY Actions secret. Google AI Studio free tier. The job picks the first candidate model the key can list (Google retired gemini-2.5-flash for new users in 2026-11). Free tiers can use prompts for training: send only public benchmark scenarios.

agents.name: aider-groq-free
agents.notes: Aider on a free API tier; needs the GROQ_API_KEY Actions secret. Groq free tier; tokens-per-minute limits are tight, so expect retries. The job picks the first candidate whose free tokens-per-minute limit fits an aider request (about 13k tokens), read from Groq's rate-limit headers. Free tiers can use prompts for training: send only public benchmark scenarios.

agents.name: aider-openrouter-free
agents.notes: Aider on a free API tier; needs the OPENROUTER_API_KEY Actions secret. OpenRouter free model; 50 requests a day without credits. The job picks the first candidate still listed with a :free id (qwen3-coder:free went paid-only in 2026-11), else the free model with the largest context. Free tiers can use prompts for training: send only public benchmark scenarios.

agents.name: aider-mistral-devstral
agents.notes: Aider on a free API tier; needs the MISTRAL_API_KEY Actions secret. Mistral La Plateforme free Experiment plan. Free tiers can use prompts for training: send only public benchmark scenarios.
agents._skip_reason: the provider asked for a credit card at sign-up (2026-11-16), so it is not a no-cost tier for this benchmark
